def: a staying, i.e. residence (the act or the place)

occurrences.text: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
